title: TikTok Shop products + discovery by keyword/category/shop.
description: TikTok Shop products + discovery by keyword/category/shop.

_signals.x_guidance: Two paid surfaces: POST /api/tools/{tool} for the first-party scrapers (records × $0.002, async over 200 records returns snapshot_id), and POST /api/skills/{slug}/run for the 703-API marketplace (flat min $0.03, sync only). Both return 402 with x402 + MPP challenges; pick what your wallet supports. Discovery: GET /api/skills lists the marketplace catalog (free). GET /api/skills/runs (SIWX) lists wallet's past skill runs. Idempotency-Key replays cached responses for 10 min on either surface.
